verdict.rationale: A system-to-system channel with a published enrollment path, such as e-file transmitter or batch-provider programs, is a fair question for a state tax agency, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only two probes, which show the front door and the filing/payment host returning HTTP 403 edge denials to a keyless agent. Nothing documents a software or transmitter channel or how to enroll in one, so absence of evidence yields "none".
